item.description:
• Watermark stage is now its own step: choose the watermark first, then size/opacity/position/padding controls appear -- not a wall of controls with nothing to apply them to yet.
  • Only one orange element on screen at a time, and it always points at the real next action: Choose Watermark while nothing's picked, Next once it is.
  • Added Skip (teal) so you can move past the watermark stage without choosing one, instead of being stuck on a disabled button.
  • Added an Acknowledgements window (App menu) with full license text for this app's one real dependency, Sparkle.

• Fixed a real bug: every release since v1.0.0 shipped Apple-Silicon-only despite the downloads page always claiming a universal build. xcodebuild's plain build command was silently constraining to the host architecture regardless of the ARCHS setting -- switched the release process to xcodebuild archive, which respects it correctly. This is the first genuinely universal (Intel + Apple Silicon) build.

• Fixed Chat mode: it never actually worked before (10s timeout vs ~28s real model latency meant every message silently fell back to the click-through flow). Now uses gemma3:4b (3-5s/turn), verified live in English and Spanish.
  • Fixed native controls (DisclosureGroup, Picker) showing the Mac's system accent color instead of Automality teal.
  • Added Sparkle auto-update -- this is the first version that can update itself.
